subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

If I was the President of India, / I would work / to ensure communal harmony.

options.text: If I was the President of India,

solution:
The correct answer is 'If I was the President of India'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is a Type 2 conditional sentence and refers to a hypothetical or unreal situation.
 
• Thesecond conditional formis given as (If + past simple tense + conditional tense (would/could/should + base form of verb)).
 
• Here, the part of the sentence,'If I was the President of India'must be replaced with'If I were the President of India'.
 
• In this case,'were'is the most correct andcommon formto be used in the given conditional sentence.

Therefore, the correct sentence should be:*If I were the President of India, I would work to ensure communal harmony.*
